reason: The frozen analysis requests paired action divergence, but the released local RoboTwin runners did not retain the exact simulator actions with hash-bearing provenance. This amendment adds measurement-only action traces before the 42 prospective cells. It does not change prompts, seeds, checkpoints, model sampling, action horizons, guidance, success predicates, or task execution.

measurement_contract.definition: The exact array passed to the RoboTwin env.take_action call at every executed step.
measurement_contract.paired_metric: RMS over the first min(10, common executed steps) inside each same-scene LEFT/RIGHT pair.
measurement_contract.historical_limit: Pairs 00-02 predate this instrumentation. Their action metric remains unavailable rather than being reconstructed or assigned zero. Prospective metric coverage is therefore seven of ten pairs per model.

files.note: Adds an explicit verified CuRobo source fallback because this checkout does not vendor CuRobo.

claim_boundary: This amendment makes a planned metric observable for prospective cells. It is not a model improvement, a protocol retune, or evidence that any checkpoint is steerable.
